title: ר' אבא בר יעקב

paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Yaakov said in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, Gittin 59a; Bava Metzia 38b, son of Rabbi Yaakov; Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter 7 of Kilayim; Tosafot, Sukkah 30b. The exilarch told him to examine the case of Chama, who had killed a person; Rav Pappi overturned his ruling, and he exempted Rav Pappi from the poll tax, Sanhedrin 27, end of a. In Rabbi Yitzchak Ruba’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Keitzad Mevarkhin, mishnah 1.
